device.name: AirSim-RL car environment (legacy Gym, AirSim simulator)

facts.text: README describes experiments with deep reinforcement learning on a car and a UAV in AirSim, an external simulator
The setup instructions say to build AirSim and Unreal Engine 4 (UE4) on Windows
The setup instructions name gym 0.17.2 as the Gym version used by the experiments
AirSimCarEnv subclasses gym.Env
The environment reads config.ini from the repository root
The action space is Discrete(int(config['car_agent']['actions']))
The shipped config.ini sets actions = 7
The shipped config.ini sets image_height 144, image_width 256 and image_channels 3
The observation space is a Box of low 0, high 255 and shape (image_height, image_width, image_channels) with dtype uint8
The shipped config.ini sets track_width = 12

step moves the car with the action, reads the car state and the car controls, computes the reward and the done flag, gets the camera observation and returns the legacy four-tuple (observation, reward, done, info)
reset restarts the car agent, gets a camera observation and returns the observation only
close calls the car agent's AirSim reset
The reward is computed from the perpendicular distance between the car and the line through the two closest waypoints, using the configured track width
The episode is done when the reward is negative, or when the car is less than 5 m from the last waypoint
The reward markers are 0.1, 0.25 and 0.5 times the track width and the rewards are 1, 0.5, 0.1 and -1 outside the third marker
CarAgent subclasses the AirSim CarClient
The car agent constructor connects to the AirSim simulator, confirms the connection and enables API control
The discrete steering values are built from steering_max and steering_granularity and the maximum steering value is appended
restart calls the AirSim reset and then enables API control again
observe requests the front camera scene image and reshapes the returned bytes to the configured image shape
move interprets the action and sends the resulting controls with setCarControls
In action mode 0 the throttle is the fixed configured value and the steering is steering_values[action]; action modes 1 and 2 return NotImplemented
The car agent fetches waypoints whose names match the configured regular expression, sorts them and reads each object's pose
The two closest waypoints are the endpoints of the segment with the smallest summed distance from the car
train.py constructs the environment as AirSimCarEnv(), the user-facing training interface

determinism.notes: the fake starts from the same fixed pose on every reset and its transition has no random source, so the same action sequence repeats the same state hashes; the bridge still accepts a seed for the next reset, but the fake ignores it; upstream reset() takes no seed, and no seeded repeatability of a live AirSim trajectory is established

fidelity.engine: analytic:legacy-gym AirSim car-track stand-in (no AirSim, Unreal Engine, physics or camera)
gaps: the fake is an analytic stand-in: it loads no AirSim, Unreal Engine, AirSim RPC client, car physics, sensor or camera model, and it is not a recording or transcript of a live AirSim run

the upstream observation Box is 144 x 256 x 3 uint8 (config.ini:3-5, gym_airsim/airsim_car_env.py:36); the fake declares and returns an 8 x 8 x 3 placeholder image to keep receipts small, so the real camera frame is NOT COVERED and no captured image is claimed
the fake's waypoint layout, start pose, step distance and steering gain are placeholders; the reward thresholds and the 5 m destination radius are the upstream rules, not measured map geometry

the upstream constructor connects to a running AirSim RPC server, confirms the connection, enables API control and fetches waypoints from scene objects (gym_airsim/car_agent.py:8-32); the fake does none of that, and the clone contains no simulator engine (README.md:17)

no live backend is offered: AirSimCarEnv is not registered with gymnasium or legacy gym and needs the external airsim package plus a running AirSim/UE4 simulator, so this package was never constructed against the upstream environment and makes no live-run claim

upstream observe() retries images until their byte count matches the configured image size with no retry bound (gym_airsim/car_agent.py:39-48); construction also prints scene waypoint names to stdout (gym_airsim/car_agent.py:68-77), which would need isolation from an MHS stdio server
there is no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor is 0 and one step is one synthetic transition, while AirSim advances continuously between setCarControls calls
the seed capability is accepted by the bridge and recorded for the next reset but does not change the deterministic fake; the upstream reset() accepts no seed and its trajectory was not checked
the e-stop is the runtime's software latch; AirSimCarEnv exposes no stop method and close() only calls the AirSim client reset (gym_airsim/airsim_car_env.py:70-72), so nothing upstream is stopped

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the fake simulated world stops advancing: the runtime refuses every step, reset and seed after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch, and the fake's last observation and state stay readable; the latch calls nothing in AirSim, and this package offers no live backend
